description: ANN serving memory before (main: build and serve in one process; later rounds rebuild the encoding from the graph cache) and after (a build process saves the vertex index; each serving process opens it: prefaulted mmap, or read into heap). Same machine, same binary flags as the harness HMS_ANN_BUILDS entries; builds on cores 12-21 with 10 threads, every serving process pinned to cores 2,3, single-threaded queries, arms interleaved with the order rotated per round. wait4_maxrss_bytes is the process peak RSS (GNU time %M); rss_bytes.end is RSS after the sweep; memory_phases are /proc/self/status and smaps_rollup readings at phase ends. cold runs drop the index file's page cache (posix_fadvise DONTNEED) and map it without prefaulting.
notes: The SIFT-1M serving rounds (5) ran before the host had a shared timing lock; the glove-100 serving rounds each held it.
glove-100 stopped after 3 of 5 rounds for the time budget; its cold and warm single-configuration runs were not run.
The cold runs in this file are SIFT-1M only, in mapped residency (index file pages dropped with posix_fadvise DONTNEED, no prefault). Cold opens of the prefaulted and heap residencies were not run.
A mapped open reads the neighbour lists and id maps while checking them, so a cold mapped open reads those sections and the first query faults in code rows.
Build times are single unpaired runs on a host shared with other work from about 16:03; they support no build-time comparison.
